svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

metadata.orrery:spec:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Sagargupta16/orrery/main/skills/orrery/references/diagram.schema.json # Rendered with orrery (github.com/Sagargupta16/orrery): # orrery render docs/diagrams/architecture.yaml -o docs/diagrams/architecture -f svg --theme both # Reviewed at README width: orrery review docs/diagrams/architecture.yaml --width 880 title: LeetCode Among Us subtitle: One Render web service proxies LeetCode for the roster; a daily GitHub Actions job keeps the history LeetCode does not direction: down legend: dashed: Daily snapshot job
groups: browser: type: boundary label: Browser (React 19 SPA) cols: 3 render: type: box label: Render web service icon: si:render cols: 2 evidence: render.yaml:8#web github: type: box label: GitHub icon: logos:github-icon
nodes: students: icon: tabler:users label: Students note: MCA, NIT Warangal stats: icon: logos:chartjs label: User Stats + Compare note: one user per call in: browser evidence: - client/src/pages/UserStats/UserStats.tsx:80#fetchOptimizedUserData - client/src/pages/Compare/Compare.tsx:218#fetchOptimizedUserData roster: icon: tabler:json label: Roster JSON note: bundled at build in: browser evidence: client/src/App.tsx:7#leetcoders_data board: icon: logos:react label: Leaderboard note: roster in batches of 10 in: browser evidence: client/src/utils/optimizedLeaderboardData.ts:76#batchSize api: icon: si:express label: Express 5 API note: Helmet, CORS, rate limit in: render evidence: server.ts:163#express cache: icon: github:cache label: In-memory cache note: TTL 10 min (history 1 h) in: render evidence: - server.ts:259#userCache - server.ts:301#historyCache history: icon: github:git-branch label: data branch note: history.json, 400 days in: github evidence: server.ts:76#HISTORY_URL snapshot: icon: logos:github-actions label: Daily snapshot note: 19:00 UTC, 1 query per user in: github evidence: .github/workflows/snapshot.yml:12#cron leetcode: icon: si:leetcode label: LeetCode GraphQL note: 5 queries + calendars per user evidence: server.ts:20#LEETCODE_GRAPHQL_URL
edges: - students -> browser - roster -> board - board, stats -> api - api -> cache - cache -> history - cache -> leetcode # Drawn after layout so the job sits beside the branch it commits to. - { from: snapshot, to: history, line: dashed, constraint: false } - { from: snapshot, to: leetcode, line: dashed, constraint: false }

svg.title: LeetCode Among Us
svg.desc: LeetCode Among Us. 9 components in 3 groups. Connections: Students to Browser (React 19 SPA); Roster JSON to Leaderboard; Leaderboard to Express 5 API; User Stats + Compare to Express 5 API; Express 5 API to In-memory cache; In-memory cache to data branch; In-memory cache to LeetCode GraphQL; Daily snapshot to data branch; Daily snapshot to LeetCode GraphQL.

text.tspan: One Render web service proxies LeetCode for the roster; a daily GitHub Actions job keeps the history
